          "archived" : false,
          "categoryId" : "SYSTEM_CONTAINER",
          "code" : "#set($contentMap = $dotcontent.find($!{ContentIdentifier}))\n#set($contentlet = $contentMap.getContentObject())\n#set($contentType = $contentlet.getContentType())\n#set($language = $languagewebapi.getLanguage(\"$!{contentlet.languageId}\"))\n\n#if($!{contentMap})\n<div class=\"system_container\">\n    #if (\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.fileName\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.asset\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.title\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.image\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.profilePhoto\")\n    )\n        <div class=\"card_logo\">\n            <img src=\"/dA/$!{contentlet.inode}\" />\n        </div>\n    #end\n\n    <div class=\"card_body\">\n        <div class=\"card_header\">\n            <div class=\"card_title\">\n                <h1>#if($title)$title#{else}$!contentlet.title#end</h1>\n            </div>\n           <span class=\"content_type\">$contentType.name()</span>\n        </div>\n        <div class=\"card_footer\">\n            <div class=\"status #if($contentlet.isLive())live#{else}working#end\"></div>\n            <span class=\"lang\">$!{language}</span>\n        </div>\n    </div>\n</div>\n#else\n<div style=\"width: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word;\">\n<h1>$text.get('message.contentlet.not.have.live.version')</h1>\n<h2>Contentlet Identifier: $!{ContentIdentifier}</h2>\n</div>\n#end",

          "archived" : false,
          "categoryId" : "SYSTEM_CONTAINER",
          "code" : "#set($contentMap = $dotcontent.find($!{ContentIdentifier}))\n#set($contentlet = $contentMap.getContentObject())\n#set($contentType = $contentlet.getContentType())\n#set($language = $languagewebapi.getLanguage(\"$!{contentlet.languageId}\"))\n\n#if($!{contentMap})\n<div class=\"system_container\">\n    #if (\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.fileName\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.asset\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.title\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.image\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.profilePhoto\")\n    )\n        <div class=\"card_logo\">\n            <img src=\"/dA/$!{contentlet.inode}\" />\n        </div>\n    #end\n\n    <div class=\"card_body\">\n        <div class=\"card_header\">\n            <div class=\"card_title\">\n                <h1>#if($title)$title#{else}$!contentlet.title#end</h1>\n            </div>\n           <span class=\"content_type\">$contentType.name()</span>\n        </div>\n        <div class=\"card_footer\">\n            <div class=\"status #if($contentlet.isLive())live#{else}working#end\"></div>\n            <span class=\"lang\">$!{language}</span>\n        </div>\n    </div>\n</div>\n#else\n<div style=\"width: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word;\">\n<h1>$text.get('message.contentlet.not.have.live.version')</h1>\n<h2>Contentlet Identifier: $!{ContentIdentifier}</h2>\n</div>\n#end",

          "archived" : false,
          "categoryId" : "SYSTEM_CONTAINER",
          "code" : "#set($contentMap = $dotcontent.find($!{ContentIdentifier}))\n#set($contentlet = $contentMap.getContentObject())\n#set($contentType = $contentlet.getContentType())\n#set($language = $languagewebapi.getLanguage(\"$!{contentlet.languageId}\"))\n\n#if($!{contentMap})\n<div class=\"system_container\">\n    #if (\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.fileName\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.asset\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.title\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.image\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.profilePhoto\")\n    )\n        <div class=\"card_logo\">\n            <img src=\"/dA/$!{contentlet.inode}\" />\n        </div>\n    #end\n\n    <div class=\"card_body\">\n        <div class=\"card_header\">\n            <div class=\"card_title\">\n                <h1>#if($title)$title#{else}$!contentlet.title#end</h1>\n            </div>\n           <span class=\"content_type\">$contentType.name()</span>\n        </div>\n        <div class=\"card_footer\">\n            <div class=\"status #if($contentlet.isLive())live#{else}working#end\"></div>\n            <span class=\"lang\">$!{language}</span>\n        </div>\n    </div>\n</div>\n#else\n<div style=\"width: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word;\">\n<h1>$text.get('message.contentlet.not.have.live.version')</h1>\n<h2>Contentlet Identifier: $!{ContentIdentifier}</h2>\n</div>\n#end",

{"entity":{"body":null,"canPublish":true,"canRead":true,"canWrite":true,"categoryId":"SYSTEM_TEMPLATE","containers":{"SYSTEM_CONTAINER":{
          "archived" : false,
          "categoryId" : "SYSTEM_CONTAINER",
          "code" : "#set($contentMap = $dotcontent.find($!{ContentIdentifier}))\n#set($contentlet = $contentMap.getContentObject())\n#set($contentType = $contentlet.getContentType())\n#set($language = $languagewebapi.getLanguage(\"$!{contentlet.languageId}\"))\n\n#if($!{contentMap})\n<div class=\"system_container\">\n    #if (\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.fileName\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.asset\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.title\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.image\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.profilePhoto\")\n    )\n        <div class=\"card_logo\">\n            <img src=\"/dA/$!{contentlet.inode}\" />\n        </div>\n    #end\n\n    <div class=\"card_body\">\n        <div class=\"card_header\">\n            <div class=\"card_title\">\n                <h1>#if($title)$title#{else}$!contentlet.title#end</h1>\n            </div>\n           <span class=\"content_type\">$contentType.name()</span>\n        </div>\n        <div class=\"card_footer\">\n            <div class=\"status #if($contentlet.isLive())live#{else}working#end\"></div>\n            <span class=\"lang\">$!{language}</span>\n        </div>\n    </div>\n</div>\n#else\n<div style=\"width: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word;\">\n<h1>$text.get('message.contentlet.not.have.live.version')</h1>\n<h2>Contentlet Identifier: $!{ContentIdentifier}</h2>\n</div>\n#end",

          "code" : "#set($contentMap = $dotcontent.find($!{ContentIdentifier}))\n#set($contentlet = $contentMap.getContentObject())\n#set($contentType = $contentlet.getContentType())\n#set($language = $languagewebapi.getLanguage(\"$!{contentlet.languageId}\"))\n\n#if($!{contentMap})\n<div class=\"system_container\">\n    #if (\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.fileName\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.asset\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.title\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.image\") ||\n        $UtilMethods.isImage(\"$contentlet.profilePhoto\")\n    )\n        <div class=\"card_logo\">\n            <img src=\"/dA/$!{contentlet.inode}\" />\n        </div>\n    #end\n\n    <div class=\"card_body\">\n        <div class=\"card_header\">\n            <div class=\"card_title\">\n                <h1>#if($title)$title#{else}$!contentlet.title#end</h1>\n            </div>\n           <span class=\"content_type\">$contentType.name()</span>\n        </div>\n        <div class=\"card_footer\">\n            <div class=\"status #if($contentlet.isLive())live#{else}working#end\"></div>\n            <span class=\"lang\">$!{language}</span>\n        </div>\n    </div>\n</div>\n#else\n<div style=\"width: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word;\">\n<h1>$text.get('message.contentlet.not.have.live.version')</h1>\n<h2>Contentlet Identifier: $!{ContentIdentifier}</h2>\n</div>\n#end",
